### About

I am a third year PhD student at the chair of Mathematical Statistics at TU Munich. I am very greatful to be supervised by [Mathias Drton](https://www.math.cit.tum.de/math/personen/professuren/drton-mathias/) and funded through [relAI](https://zuseschoolrelai.de). 

My research area is non-parametric Statistics and Machine Learning. In particular, I study incomplete observation models and robustness.

### Research Interests

* Causal identification from cross-sectional data

* Generative Diffusion Models

* Robust mean estimation
